text: Maaku an Nulaaɗo : Ko onon yo yimɓe, gomɗii Alqur'aana arii e mon, jippiniraande Joomi mon. Kala feewuɗo o gomɗini nde, nafa mun ko e makko yiltotoo; tawde Alla ko yonndiniiɗo gaay e dewe jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Kala kadi majjuɗo, haray battane majjere makko nden ko e makko tun defotoo. Alla lorrortah geddi jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Min non wonaa mi fawaaɗo reenugol golle mon, sakko mi hasba on e majje.
